verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships a built-in AI agent, Tia, that is pitched as fixing IT issues and building automations. It also offers an AI troubleshooting assistant queried in natural language and an AI note-taker that writes a summary for each support case, so users can hand off summarization, diagnosis and log or screenshot analysis inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which tasks Tia can carry out on its own beyond summaries and Q&A, and any independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is marketing and pricing-page copy).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Tia’s automated session summaries save you time, augment your human experts, and help Tia build new automations to cut digital friction and time-wasting repetitive tasks.
Our AI-powered note-taker compiles a summary for each case, spots patterns, highlights insights
Use advanced TeamViewer AI to analyze data, from screenshots to error logs.
